body.heading: Write your name
paragraphs: Write your name in big letters down the left side of the page, one letter on each line.
Look at the first letter. Think of a happy word that starts with that sound.

body.heading: Grow each line
paragraphs: Turn each letter into a short line. For A you might write: Apples are my favourite snack.
Read your poem out loud when it is finished. You have made your very first poem.

takeaway: Your own name can be the start of a poem that is all about you.
safetyNotes: Only use your first name, and keep your poem at home with your family.
screenFreeExtension: Make an acrostic poem for someone in your family as a surprise gift.
